info.name: Amazon S3 Control Access Control Batch Operations API
Amazon S3 List Batch Operations Jobs

params.name: jobStatuses
params.description: The List Jobs request returns jobs that match the statuses listed.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A pagination token to request the next page of results.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of jobs to return.

items.docs: Lists current S3 Batch Operations jobs as well as the jobs that have ended within the last 30 days for the AWS account making the request.

info.name: Amazon S3 Create Batch Operations Job

items.docs: Creates an S3 Batch Operations job to perform the specified operation on every object in the specified manifest. You can create a job that performs PUT copy, invoke an AWS Lambda function, initiate S3 Glacier restore, replace tagging, delete objects, or replicate objects.

info.name: Amazon S3 Describe Batch Operations Job

params.name: id
params.description: The ID for the job whose information you want to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration parameters and status for a Batch Operations job. For more information, see S3 Batch Operations in the Amazon S3 User Guide.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID for the job whose priority you want to update.

params.name: priority
params.description: The priority you want to assign to this job.

items.docs: Updates an existing S3 Batch Operations job's priority. You can use this operation to increase or decrease the priority of a job. Higher number priorities are processed first.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the job whose status you want to update.

params.name: requestedJobStatus
params.description: The status that you want to move the specified job to.

params.name: statusUpdateReason
params.description: A description of the reason why you want to change the job status.

items.docs: Updates the status for the specified job. Use this action to confirm that you want to run a job or to cancel an existing job.
